reason: The patch changes `.small-action-desc .custom-message p` from `margin: 5px 0` to `margin: 0` (app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:291-293), and that div renders `{{{post.cooked}}}` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:16), so consecutive cooked paragraphs get no vertical gap; no other stylesheet rule restores it. Paragraphs still break onto separate lines, so the effect is purely cosmetic.
